pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Alert pattern (role=alert) for urgent dynamic messages; role=status for polite updates; plain content when static.

aria.value: status or alert when live is enabled; absent otherwise

keyboard.action: Moves through action buttons, then the dismiss button, in reading order.
Emits cancelable aui-dismiss, then hides the alert.

focus: The alert never moves focus. Buttons show their own focus indicator. After dismissal, focus management is up to the consumer (handle aui-dismiss).
notes: Tone is conveyed by an icon and a visually hidden, localized prefix such as 'Error:', never by color alone.
Live roles announce only content inserted or changed after the region exists; static page content should use live 'off'.
role=alert is assertive and interrupts; reserve it for errors and time-sensitive warnings.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
